symbols.name: axis bound
symbols.meaning: An upper bound on the number D of selected axes in one layer, a count of axes.
symbols.quote: Here $d$ is an upper bound on the number $D$ of selected axes in a layer.

symbols.name: cost exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent below one in the layer cost O(V d^{\lambda'}).
symbols.quote: Here $\lambda'$ is a fixed exponent below one, so that the cost is $O(V d^{\lambda'})$.

symbols.name: role count
symbols.meaning: The number of roles in the network, a count of the wire roles among which rows are distributed.
symbols.quote: The argument needs each recursive call to make fewer than $Wm$ smaller calls, where $W$ is the number of roles in the network.

relations.quote: The numerical layer computes the [Simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md) on its selected bits, in one pass rather than one axis at a time.
